summary: D1 lands the detective layer now: check-durable-tier.py fails in CI on non-markdown artifacts under the note roots, notes over the budget byte bound, fenced JSON blocks over the dump threshold, and uninventoried non-markdown artifacts under .concord/docs/decisions, with all bounds single-sourced from .concord/docs/durable-tier-budget.v1.json and zero tolerance with no ratchet; D2 sets the bound at 16384 bytes over the compaction-note roots docs/work and .concord/docs/lessons, keeps decision records out of the byte bound as a different artifact class, and enforces markdown-only for them through a declared inventory with reasons; D3 records the producer-side strict typed parse as the contract the future compaction pipeline must satisfy, reading the same budget; D4 extends AJ6-compact-terminal-work to assert the compaction path emits an in-budget note; D5 states why three layers: the detective binds every writer at the merge chokepoint, the producer parse catches violations cheapest at write time, and the scenario observes pipeline behavior over time.
title: The durable tier is enforced, not advised
